name: Bank Millennium S.A.
summary: Bank Millennium S.A. provides various banking products and services in Poland. It operates through Retail Customer; Corporate Customer; and Treasury, Assets and Liabilities Management, and Other segments. The company offers current, savings, foreign currency savings, individual investment retirement, private banking, business, and VAT accounts; and term and structured deposits. It also provides investment advisory; investment plan and funds; credit, debit, and prepaid cards; cash, promotional online, mortgage, home equity, renewable loans, as well as consolidation loan with fixed interest rate, EKO promotional mortgage, personal account overdraft limit, loans secured with assets accumulated …
